limits: No public Sepolia RPC/registry/signer configured or public transaction sent. Target and operation approval required by AGENTS.md and P2 plan.
Pending may remain indefinitely if crash occurs before broadcast or a transaction is not found; no automatic retransmission/cancellation/replacement.
File and directory fsync tested via implementation/process tests, not physical power loss, remote disk failure, volume loss or stale backup rollback.
One cooperating Linux writer and exclusive issuer; no multi-instance or external wallet nonce coordination.
Canonicality checked on demand, no reorg watcher or Ethereum finality guarantee.
Revocation immediately after final directory check can race with broadcast; directory and blockchain are not atomic.
Independent verifier process shares chain implementation and trusts configured RPC.
UI responses are DEMO fixtures; actual transactions verified separately on disposable local chain. No physical device/screen reader acceptance claimed.
P3-P6, human domain expert review, real-user pilot, model benchmark and deployment remain pending.
